[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
def implementation (string: String) : List String :=
let rec loop (remaining: String) (prefixes: List String) : List String :=
  match remaining with
  | "" => prefixes
  | head :: tail =>
    let new_prefix := string.take (string.length - remaining.length)
    loop tail (new_prefix :: prefixes)
loop string []
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
  unfold problem_spec
  let result := implementation string
  use result
  simp [result]
  simp [implementation]
  have h_length := by
